about: AIの検査, stage 0: labelled Japanese chat lines for the money check (findMoney in agent/screen.mjs and client/src/lib/ai-screen.ts). money: moving money, payment details, accounts, gift cards, crypto, money pitches. everyday: family and friend chat with prices, numbers, times and shops, but no money moving between people. Written for the test; names, accounts, codes and addresses are made up or well-known examples. heldOut: written after the rules were first made, to measure them on lines they were not tuned on (measured once before tuning: 22 of 30 found, 0 of 30 everyday lines flagged).
